name: Acrobat’s Slippers
body:
Price 3,000 gp; Aura faint transmutation; CL 3; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This pair of fine slippers are adorned with embroidery of cats stretched out in various poses. While wearing acrobat’s slippers you always land on your feet when you fall and gain a +2 bonus on Acrobatics checks. In addition, twice per day you may activate the slippers as a free action to gain the effects of a cheetah’s sprint spell.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 1,500 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item, cat’s grace, cheetah’s sprint
